metadata.title: Adaptive Subgradient Methods for Online Learning and Stochastic Optimization
metadata.authors: John Duchi, Elad Hazan, Yoram Singer
metadata.source_note: Extracted from PDF->text fallback; .tex source not available. Math fidelity reduced.

nodes.name: Bregman Divergence
nodes.statement: For a strongly convex differentiable $\psi$, $B_\psi(x,y) = \psi(x) - \psi(y) - \langle \nabla\psi(y), x-y\rangle$.
nodes.statement_clean: Standard Bregman divergence associated with a strongly convex function psi.

nodes.name: Subgradient sequence and outer product matrix
nodes.statement: Let $g_{1:t} = [g_1 \cdots g_t]$, with $i$th row $g_{1:t,i}$. Define $G_t = \sum_{\tau=1}^{t} g_\tau g_\tau^\top$.
nodes.statement_clean: Concatenated subgradient matrix and the cumulative outer-product matrix used throughout the paper.

nodes.name: Regret
nodes.statement: Online regret against fixed $x^* \in X$: $R(T) = \sum_{t=1}^{T} f_t(x_t) - \inf_{x \in X} \sum_{t=1}^{T} f_t(x)$.

nodes.name: Mahalanobis norm and projection
nodes.statement: $\|\cdot\|_A = \sqrt{\langle \cdot, A\cdot\rangle}$ and $\Pi^A_X(y) = \arg\min_{x \in X} \langle x-y, A(x-y)\rangle$.

nodes.name: Composite regret
nodes.statement: For composite losses $\phi_t(x) = f_t(x) + \varphi(x)$: $R_\phi(T) = \sum_{t=1}^{T}[\phi_t(x_t) - \phi_t(x^*)]$.
nodes.statement_clean: Regret extended to composite (loss + regularizer) form.

nodes.name: Strong convexity w.r.t. semi-norm
nodes.statement: $\psi$ is 1-strongly convex w.r.t. $\|\cdot\|_\psi$ iff $\psi(y) \geq \psi(x) + \langle \nabla\psi(x), y-x\rangle + \tfrac{1}{2}\|x-y\|^2_\psi$, equivalently $B_\psi(x,y) \geq \tfrac{1}{2}\|x-y\|^2_\psi$.

nodes.name: AdaGrad proximal matrices
nodes.statement: Set $H_t = \delta I + \mathrm{diag}(G_t)^{1/2}$ (Diagonal) or $H_t = \delta I + G_t^{1/2}$ (Full); proximal $\psi_t(x) = \tfrac{1}{2}\langle x, H_t x\rangle$.

nodes.name: Diagonal AdaGrad update (no regularizer)
nodes.statement: $x_{t+1} = \Pi_X^{\mathrm{diag}(G_t)^{1/2}}\!\left(x_t - \eta\, \mathrm{diag}(G_t)^{-1/2} g_t\right)$.

nodes.name: Primal-dual subgradient (RDA) update
nodes.statement: $x_{t+1} = \arg\min_{x \in X}\!\big\{\eta\langle \bar g_t, x\rangle + \eta\varphi(x) + \tfrac{1}{t}\psi_t(x)\big\}$.

nodes.name: Composite mirror-descent update
nodes.statement: $x_{t+1} = \arg\min_{x \in X}\!\big\{\eta\langle g_t, x\rangle + \eta\varphi(x) + B_{\psi_t}(x, x_t)\big\}$.

nodes.name: Regret bound for primal-dual subgradient with time-varying psi
nodes.statement: If $\{x_t\}$ follows the primal-dual update (3), then $\sum_{t=1}^{T}[f_t(x_t)+\varphi(x_t)-f_t(x^*)-\varphi(x^*)] \leq \tfrac{1}{\eta}\psi_T(x^*) + \tfrac{\eta}{2}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\|f_t'(x_t)\|^2_{\psi^*_{t-1}}$.

nodes.name: Regret bound for composite mirror descent with time-varying psi
nodes.statement: If $\{x_t\}$ follows update (4) with $\varphi(x_1)=0$, then the regret is bounded by $\tfrac{1}{\eta}B_{\psi_1}(x^*,x_1) + \tfrac{1}{\eta}\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}[B_{\psi_{t+1}}(x^*,x_{t+1}) - B_{\psi_t}(x^*,x_{t+1})] + \tfrac{\eta}{2}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\|f_t'(x_t)\|^2_{\psi^*_t}$.

nodes.name: AdaGrad with diagonal matrices
nodes.statement: Adaptive subgradient method that maintains per-coordinate sums $s_{t,i}=\|g_{1:t,i}\|_2$ and proximal $H_t=\delta I + \mathrm{diag}(s_t)$, used inside primal-dual or composite mirror-descent updates.

nodes.name: AdaGrad with full matrices
nodes.statement: Adaptive subgradient method using $S_t = G_t^{1/2}$ where $G_t=\sum_{\tau\leq t}g_\tau g_\tau^\top$, with proximal $H_t=\delta I + S_t$ inside primal-dual or composite mirror-descent updates.

nodes.name: Optimal diagonal proximal selection
nodes.statement: Find $s \succeq 0$ minimizing $\sum_{t=1}^T \sum_{i=1}^d g_{t,i}^2/s_i$ subject to $\langle 1, s\rangle \leq c$.

nodes.name: Optimal full-matrix proximal selection
nodes.statement: Find $S \succeq 0$ minimizing $\sum_{t=1}^{T} \langle g_t, S^{-1} g_t\rangle$ subject to $\mathrm{tr}(S) \leq c$.

nodes.name: Sum-of-norms doubling inequality (diagonal)
nodes.statement: Let $g_t = f_t'(x_t)$ and $s_{t,i} = \|g_{1:t,i}\|_2$. Then $\sum_{t=1}^{T} \langle g_t, \mathrm{diag}(s_t)^{-1} g_t\rangle \leq 2\sum_{i=1}^d \|g_{1:T,i}\|_2$.
nodes.origin_citation: originally Auer & Gentile 2000; also McMahan & Streeter 2010

nodes.name: Diagonal AdaGrad regret bound (Theorem 5)
nodes.statement: For Algorithm 1 with primal-dual update and $\delta \geq \max_t \|g_t\|_\infty$: $R_\phi(T) \leq \tfrac{\delta}{\eta}\|x^*\|_2^2 + \tfrac{1}{\eta}\|x^*\|_\infty^2 \sum_i \|g_{1:T,i}\|_2 + \eta \sum_i \|g_{1:T,i}\|_2$. Composite mirror-descent: $R_\phi(T) \leq \tfrac{1}{2\eta}\max_{t\leq T}\|x^*-x_t\|_\infty^2 \sum_i \|g_{1:T,i}\|_2 + \eta \sum_i \|g_{1:T,i}\|_2$.

nodes.name: Corollary 1 (introductory diagonal regret)
nodes.statement: If $\max_t \|x^* - x_t\|_\infty \leq D_\infty$ and $\eta = D_\infty/\sqrt{2}$, then $R_\phi(T) \leq \sqrt{2d}\, D_\infty \inf_{s \succeq 0,\, \langle 1,s\rangle \leq d}\sqrt{\sum_{t=1}^T \|g_t\|^2_{\mathrm{diag}(s)^{-1}}} = \sqrt{2}\, D_\infty \sum_{i=1}^d \|g_{1:T,i}\|_2$.

nodes.name: Corollary 6 (simplified diagonal AdaGrad regret)
nodes.statement: For Algorithm 1 with primal-dual update and $\eta = \|x^*\|_\infty$: $R_\phi(T) \leq 2\|x^*\|_\infty \gamma_T + \delta \|x^*\|_1$. For composite mirror-descent with $\eta = D_\infty/\sqrt 2$: $R_\phi(T) \leq \sqrt 2 D_\infty \gamma_T$, where $\gamma_T = \sum_i \|g_{1:T,i}\|_2$.

nodes.name: Full-matrix AdaGrad regret bound (Theorem 7)
nodes.statement: For Algorithm 2 with primal-dual update and $\delta \geq \max_t \|g_t\|_2$: $R_\phi(T) \leq \tfrac{\delta}{\eta}\|x^*\|_2^2 + \tfrac{1}{\eta}\|x^*\|_2^2 \mathrm{tr}(G_T^{1/2}) + \eta\, \mathrm{tr}(G_T^{1/2})$. Composite mirror descent ($\delta \geq 0$): $R_\phi(T) \leq \tfrac{\delta}{\eta}\|x^*\|_2^2 + \tfrac{1}{2\eta}\max_{t \leq T}\|x^* - x_t\|_2^2 \mathrm{tr}(G_T^{1/2}) + \eta \mathrm{tr}(G_T^{1/2})$.

nodes.name: Corollary 11 (simplified full-matrix AdaGrad regret)
nodes.statement: For Algorithm 2 with primal-dual update and $\eta=\|x^*\|_2$: $R_\phi(T) \leq 2\|x^*\|_2 \mathrm{tr}(G_T^{1/2}) + \delta\|x^*\|_2$. For composite mirror descent with $X$ compact ($\sup\|x-x^*\|_2 \leq D$), $\eta = D/\sqrt 2$, $\delta=0$: $R_\phi(T) \leq \sqrt 2 D\, \mathrm{tr}(G_T^{1/2}) = \sqrt{2d}\, D\, \sqrt{\inf_S\{\sum_t g_t^\top S^{-1} g_t : S \succeq 0,\, \mathrm{tr}(S) \leq d\}}$.

nodes.name: Corollary 12 (block-diagonal AdaGrad regret)
nodes.statement: For block-diagonal $G_t$ and the RDA update with $\psi_t(x) = \langle x, G_t^{1/2} x\rangle$: $R_\phi(T) \leq \tfrac{1}{\eta}\max_i \|x^*_{[i]}\|_2^2 \mathrm{tr}(G_T^{1/2}) + \eta \mathrm{tr}(G_T^{1/2})$.

nodes.name: Concavity of trace-root with rank-one perturbation (Lemma 8)
nodes.statement:
Let $B \succeq 0$ and $B^{-1/2}$ denote the (pseudo-)inverse root. For any $
u$ such that $B - 
u g g^	op \succeq 0$: $2\,\mathrm{tr}((B - 
u gg^	op)^{1/2}) \leq 2\,\mathrm{tr}(B^{1/2}) - 
u\, \mathrm{tr}(B^{-1/2} gg^	op)$.

nodes.name: Dual-norm comparison (Lemma 9)
nodes.statement: If $\delta \geq \|g\|_2$ and $A \succeq 0$, then $\langle g, (\delta I + A^{1/2})^{-1} g\rangle \leq \langle g, ((A + gg^\top)^\dagger)^{1/2} g\rangle$.
conclusions: $\langle g, (\delta I + A^{1/2})^{-1} g\rangle \leq \langle g, ((A+gg^\top)^\dagger)^{1/2} g\rangle$

nodes.name: Sum-of-norms doubling inequality (full-matrix, Lemma 10)
nodes.statement: Let $S_t = G_t^{1/2}$. Then $\sum_{t=1}^T \langle g_t, S_t^\dagger g_t\rangle \leq 2 \sum_{t=1}^T \langle g_t, S_T^\dagger g_t\rangle = 2\, \mathrm{tr}(G_T^{1/2})$.

nodes.name: Operator monotonicity of square root (Lemma 13)
nodes.statement: If $A \succeq B \succeq 0$ are symmetric PSD, then $A^{1/2} \succeq B^{1/2}$.

nodes.name: Gradient of trace power (Lemma 14)
nodes.statement: For $p \in \mathbb{R}$ and $X \succ 0$: $\nabla_X \mathrm{tr}(X^p) = p X^{p-1}$.

nodes.name: Optimal trace-constrained quadratic (Lemma 15)
nodes.statement: For $A \succeq 0$, $\min_{S \succeq 0,\, \mathrm{tr}(S) \leq c} \mathrm{tr}(S^{-1} A)$ is attained at $S = c A^{1/2}/\mathrm{tr}(A^{1/2})$, with value $\mathrm{tr}(A^{1/2})^2/c$ (using pseudo-inverse if $A$ is singular).

nodes.name: Composite mirror-descent per-step inequality (Lemma 16)
nodes.statement: For $\{x_t\}$ defined by the composite mirror-descent update with $B_{\psi_t}$ strongly convex, a per-step inequality bounds $f_t(x_t)+\varphi(x_{t+1}) - f_t(x^*) - \varphi(x^*)$ by Bregman differences plus dual-norm subgradient term.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 5 (diagonal AdaGrad)
nodes.statement: Combine Lemma 4's bound on the gradient terms with bounds on Bregman-divergence increments and on $\psi_T(x^*)$, then plug into Propositions 2 and 3.

nodes.name: Bound dual norms by sum
nodes.statement: Apply Lemma 4 to obtain $\sum_{t=1}^T \|f_t'(x_t)\|^2_{\psi^*_t} \leq 2 \sum_i \|g_{1:T,i}\|_2$.

nodes.name: Bound Bregman-divergence increments
nodes.statement: Show $B_{\psi_{t+1}}(x^*,x_{t+1})-B_{\psi_t}(x^*,x_{t+1}) \leq \tfrac{1}{2}\max_i (x_i^* - x_{t+1,i})^2 \|s_{t+1}-s_t\|_1$ and telescope.

nodes.name: Bound psi_T(x*) and combine
nodes.statement: Use $\psi_T(x^*) \leq \delta\|x^*\|_2^2 + \|x^*\|_\infty^2 \sum_i \|g_{1:T,i}\|_2$ and combine with Propositions 2 and 3.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 7 (full-matrix AdaGrad)
nodes.statement: Bound Bregman-divergence increments via $\lambda_{\max}(G_{t+1}^{1/2}-G_t^{1/2}) \leq \mathrm{tr}(G_{t+1}^{1/2}-G_t^{1/2})$ (Lemma 13), then bound the gradient sum using Lemmas 8-10, and combine with Propositions 2, 3.

nodes.name: Eigenvalue-vs-trace step
nodes.statement: Use $\lambda_{\max}(M) \leq \mathrm{tr}(M)$ for $M = G_{t+1}^{1/2} - G_t^{1/2}$ (PSD by Lemma 13) to bound divergence increments.

nodes.name: Telescope divergence increments
nodes.statement: Sum the per-step bounds to obtain $\sum_t \big(B_{\psi_{t+1}}-B_{\psi_t}\big) \leq \tfrac{1}{2}\max_t \|x^*-x_t\|_2^2 \mathrm{tr}(G_T^{1/2}) - \tfrac{1}{2}\|x^*-x_1\|_2^2 \mathrm{tr}(G_1^{1/2})$.

nodes.name: Bound gradient terms by trace
nodes.statement: Using Lemmas 8, 9, 10, conclude $\sum_t \|f_t'(x_t)\|^2_{\psi^*_t} \leq 2\,\mathrm{tr}(G_T^{1/2})$ (and analogous for $\psi^*_{t-1}$).

nodes.name: Combine via Propositions 2 and 3
nodes.statement: Plug the three bounds into Propositions 2 and 3 to get the regret statements for primal-dual and composite mirror descent variants.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma 4 (Appendix C)
nodes.statement: By induction on $T$, prove $\sum_{t=1}^T a_t^2/\|a_{1:t}\|_2 \leq 2 \|a_{1:T}\|_2$ using concavity of $\sqrt{\cdot}$, then specialize to $a_t = g_{t,i}$ and sum over coordinates.

nodes.name: Inductive step using concavity
nodes.statement: Assume bound at $T-1$, then $2\|a_{1:T-1}\|_2 + a_T^2/\|a_{1:T}\|_2 = 2\sqrt{b_T - a_T^2} + a_T^2/\sqrt{b_T} \leq 2\sqrt{b_T}$ by $\sqrt{b - x} \leq \sqrt b - x/(2\sqrt b)$.

nodes.name: Sum over coordinates
nodes.statement: Apply (24) with $a_t = g_{t,i}$ for each $i$ and sum to get $\sum_t \langle g_t, \mathrm{diag}(s_t)^{-1} g_t\rangle \leq 2\sum_i \|g_{1:T,i}\|_2$.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma 8 (Appendix D)
nodes.statement: Use matrix-concavity of $A^p$ for $0 \leq p \leq 1$, take a perturbation argument with $\delta I$ to handle degeneracy of the pseudo-inverse, and apply the first-order concavity inequality with $\nabla \mathrm{tr}(B^{1/2}) = \tfrac{1}{2}B^{-1/2}$.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma 10 (Appendix not separately labeled)
nodes.statement: Induction on $T$ combined with Lemma 8 applied to $B = G_T,\ \nu = 1,\ g = g_T$ to exploit concavity of $\mathrm{tr}(A^{1/2})$ and bound the cumulative sum by $2\,\mathrm{tr}(G_T^{1/2})$.

nodes.name: Sparse heavy-tailed feature scenario
nodes.statement: Hinge-loss data with $z_t \in \{-1,0,1\}^d$ and feature $i$ active with probability $p_i = \min(1, c i^{-\alpha})$ shows AdaGrad regret $O(\max\{\log d, d^{1-\alpha/2}\}\sqrt T)$ versus standard $O(\sqrt{dT})$.

nodes.name: Diagonal adaptation perfect-classifier example
nodes.statement: Adversarial sequence with $z_t = \pm e_i$ shows diagonal AdaGrad recovers the perfect classifier $x^* = 1$ after $d$ updates while gradient descent suffers loss $\geq d/(2\varepsilon)$.

nodes.name: Full-matrix adaptation orthonormal example
nodes.statement: Adversary cycling $z_t = \pm v_i$ over an orthonormal basis: full-matrix AdaGrad suffers loss at most $d$ while projected gradient descent suffers $\Omega(d/\varepsilon)$.

nodes.name: Reuters RCV1 text classification
nodes.statement: On four Reuters categories with bigram features, AdaGrad-RDA and AdaGrad-FOBOS attain lower test error than RDA, FOBOS, PA, and AROW (Table 1).

nodes.name: ImageNet image ranking
nodes.statement: Training 15{,}000 per-class rankers with visterms features: AdaGrad-RDA attains higher average precision than AROW, PA, and RDA while using only 73% non-zero features (Table 2).

nodes.name: MNIST multiclass with Gaussian kernels
nodes.statement: Using kernel-feature 30{,}000-dim multiclass setup, adaptive RDA matches or beats PA and dominates non-adaptive RDA, with mixed-norm $\ell_1/\ell_2$ regularization yielding sparser solutions (Table 3, Fig. 5).

nodes.name: KDD census income prediction
nodes.statement: On the 4001-dim census features, adaptive methods (AROW and AdaGrad-RDA) outperform non-adaptive RDA and PA across training proportions (Table 4, Fig. 6).

nodes.name: Generalized scaled $\ell_1$-projection
nodes.statement: $O(d \log d)$ algorithm projecting $v \succ 0$ onto $\{z : \langle a, z\rangle \leq c,\ z \succeq 0\}$ via sort + threshold $z^*_i = [v_i - \theta a_i]_+$.

nodes.name: Bisection solver for $\ell_2$-regularized proximal step
nodes.statement: Bisection in $\theta$ on the dual to compute $x = \arg\min_x \langle u,x\rangle + \tfrac{1}{2}\langle x, Hx\rangle + \lambda\|x\|_2$.

nodes.name: Diagonal AdaGrad-RDA closed form (l1)
nodes.statement: $x_{t+1,i} = \mathrm{sign}(-\bar g_{t,i})\, \tfrac{\eta t}{H_{t,ii}}\, [|\bar g_{t,i}| - \lambda]_+$, where $H_{t,ii} = \delta + \|g_{1:t,i}\|_2$.

nodes.name: Diagonal AdaGrad-FOBOS closed form (l1)
nodes.statement: $x_{t+1,i} = \mathrm{sign}(x_{t,i} - \tfrac{\eta}{H_{t,ii}}g_{t,i})\, [|x_{t,i} - \tfrac{\eta}{H_{t,ii}} g_{t,i}| - \tfrac{\lambda \eta}{H_{t,ii}}]_+$.

nodes.name: Comparison to AROW
nodes.statement: Unlike AROW, which uses the inverse covariance directly, AdaGrad uses the root of the inverse covariance; runtimes are comparable in the diagonal case.

nodes.name: Concurrent McMahan-Streeter work
nodes.statement: McMahan & Streeter (2010) independently propose closely related adaptive algorithms and analyze a competitive-ratio variant of the same bounds.

nodes.name: Zinkevich projected-gradient regret bound (cited)
nodes.statement: Online gradient descent with optimal $\eta$ satisfies $R(T) \leq \sqrt 2 D_2 \sqrt{\sum_{t=1}^T \|g_t\|_2^2}$ when $\sup_{x,y \in X}\|x-y\|_2 \leq D_2$.

nodes.name: Efficient full-matrix proximal AdaGrad
nodes.statement: Can the full-matrix proximal functions of Section 4 be implemented efficiently enough for large-scale problems?

nodes.name: Non-Euclidean proximal extensions
nodes.statement: Can non-Euclidean proximal functions (e.g., relative entropy / KL) be combined with the AdaGrad adaptation paradigm?

nodes.name: AdaGrad in the strongly convex regime
nodes.statement: Can the AdaGrad framework be extended to obtain improved bounds when $f_t$ or $\varphi$ is strongly convex?
